name: chrome
description: Control Chrome with a plugin-bundled Chrome MCP runtime, Chrome extension, and Native Messaging host.

shortDescription.en-US: Use Chrome tabs through the Anybox Chrome extension.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 通过 Anybox Chrome 扩展使用 Chrome 标签页。

longDescription.en-US: A self-contained Chrome plugin that bundles its Chrome MCP, Node REPL, Chrome runtime, and built Chrome extension. The complete extension and Native Messaging Host projects remain available in the GitHub source repository.
longDescription.zh-CN: 一个自包含的 Chrome 插件，内含 Chrome MCP、Node REPL、Chrome 运行时与构建后的 Chrome 扩展；完整扩展和 Native Messaging Host 工程保留在 GitHub 源码仓库中。

mcpServers.name: Chrome
mcpServers.description: Inspect and control Chrome tabs through the Anybox Chrome extension.

tools.name: browser_status
tools.title: Chrome Status
tools.description: Check whether the Anybox Chrome extension is connected.

tools.name: browser_get_tabs
tools.title: Get Chrome Tabs
tools.description: List Chrome tabs visible to the Anybox Chrome extension.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.title: Chrome Snapshot
tools.description: Read page title, URL, visible text, links, buttons, and inputs.

tools.name: browser_interactive_snapshot
tools.title: Chrome Interactive Snapshot
tools.description: List visible clickable and fillable page elements with stable element IDs.

tools.name: browser_dom_tree
tools.title: Chrome DOM Tree
tools.description: Read a compact DOM tree for a Chrome page.

tools.name: browser_accessibility_tree
tools.title: Chrome Accessibility Tree
tools.description: Read Chrome's accessibility tree for a page.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.title: Chrome Screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot of a Chrome tab.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.title: Chrome Click
tools.description: Click viewport coordinates in a Chrome tab.

tools.name: browser_click_element
tools.title: Chrome Click Element
tools.description: Click an element returned by browser_interactive_snapshot.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.title: Chrome Fill
tools.description: Fill an input-like element returned by browser_interactive_snapshot.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.title: Chrome Type
tools.description: Insert text into the focused element in a Chrome tab.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.title: Chrome Scroll
tools.description: Scroll a Chrome tab by a viewport delta.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.title: Chrome Wait For
tools.description: Wait until a Chrome page reaches a URL, text, selector, or element condition.

tools.name: browser_release_tab
tools.title: Chrome Release Tab
tools.description: Release a Chrome tab from session ownership without closing it.

permissions: Reads Chrome tab titles, URLs, visible page text, DOM trees, accessibility trees, interactive elements, and screenshots.
Opens, activates, clicks, scrolls, types into, and fills Chrome tabs through the Anybox Chrome extension.
Requires the Anybox Chrome extension to be installed, enabled, and connected.
installReview: Runs a local Node.js MCP server bundled inside the Chrome plugin.
Requires the Anybox Chrome extension to be connected before browser commands can run.
Interactive page actions are configured to ask before execution.

mcpServers.name: Node REPL
mcpServers.description: Run JavaScript in a persistent local Node.js REPL with Chrome runtime helpers.

tools.name: node_repl_js
tools.title: Node REPL JavaScript
tools.description: Run JavaScript in a persistent Node.js REPL.

tools.name: node_repl_reset
tools.title: Reset Node REPL
tools.description: Reset the persistent Node.js REPL state.

tools.name: node_repl_add_node_module_dir
tools.title: Add Node Module Directory
tools.description: Add a node_modules directory to CommonJS module resolution.

permissions: Runs JavaScript requested by the agent in a persistent local process, including local module, filesystem, and network access.
Uses the plugin-bundled Chrome runtime adapter for raw page JavaScript and Chrome DevTools Protocol commands.
installReview: Runs a persistent local JavaScript process bundled inside the Chrome plugin.
JavaScript can load local modules and access the local filesystem and network.
Raw page script and Chrome DevTools Protocol access are configured to ask before execution.

skillPreviews.name: Chrome
skillPreviews.description: Use when the Chrome plugin is enabled and the user asks to inspect or control Chrome through its bundled Chrome MCP or Node REPL runtime.
